# Pick any vertex v. It has 4 neighbors. Each neighbor has 3 other neighbors.
# For girth >= 5: no two neighbors of v can share another neighbor (would create C4)
# and neighbors of v cannot be adjacent (would create C3).
# So v's neighborhood: 4 vertices, plus 4*3=12 distinct second-neighbors, plus v itself = 17.
# With only 8 vertices, impossible.
print("Need >= 17 vertices, have 8. UNSAT.")
